results.overview: Charting the life of Isabella I of Castile, one of the most important women in Spain’s history, Isabel follows her passionate story from childhood to being crowned Queen. From her political struggles within King Henry IV's court to her wedding to Ferdinand of Aragon, the drama encapsulates the passions, emotions and sacrifices of a woman who refused to just be a figurehead and whose outlook was ahead of her time.
results.name: Isabel

results.overview: Native American girl Maria Isabel makes friends with Graciela, a rich white girl, despite Graciela's father's opposition; their friendship lasts into their adulthood.
results.name: María Isabel

results.overview: From a young age, Isabel was willing to break all the socially accepted standards of her time to pursue happiness and blaze her own path. Then, at the peak of her career, she receives the devastating news that her daughter is on the verge of dying. The pain may have bent her, but it never broke her.
results.name: Isabel

results.overview:
Mi querida Isabel is a Mexican telenovela produced by Angelli Nesma Medina for Televisa and originally broadcast on Canal de las Estrellas from December 9, 1996, to April 25, 1997. It is a remake of the 1975 telenovela Paloma, based on the original story by Marissa Garrido.

The story follows Isabel Rivas, a hardworking law student who has taken responsibility for her family after the death of the woman she believes was her mother. As she falls in love with Juan Daniel Márquez, she becomes involved in a web of family secrets and discovers that her real mother, Sagrario, has spent nearly twenty years in prison for a crime she did not commit. Determined to uncover the truth, Isabel fights for justice, love, and the reunion of her family.
results.name: Mi querida Isabel

results.overview: Isabel Preysler welcomes us in the privacy of her home to show us how she celebrates one of the most memorable dates of the year: Christmas. With her staff's help, Isabel oversees even the most minute details and shares the joy of the present and the nostalgia of the past with her children.
results.name: Isabel Preysler: My Christmas

results.overview: A powerful and unique series about one of Norway's most successful influencers, Isabel Raad. After four years of being single, she can feel her biological clock ticking. One impulsive text message to her ex changes everything. We follow Isabel through love and crises in an intimate story about family, trauma, and hope. For the first time, the series reveals who her dream man is, and how they met.
results.name: Isabel Raad: Behind the Curtains

results.overview:
María Isabel is a Mexican telenovela, which was produced and broadcast by Televisa in 1997. Starring Adela Noriega, Fernando Carrillo and Lorena Herrera. María Isabel, is one of the few telenovelas that focuses on the life of an indigenous female protagonist and her community.

The original story was written by Yolanda Vargas Dulché and the TV version was adapted by René Muñoz.
results.name: Si tú supieras... María Isabel

results.original_name: Cocaïne, prison & likes : la vraie histoire d'Isabelle
results.overview: In 2016, Isabelle Lagacé and Mélina Roberge are arrested for importing cocaine aboard a cruise ship in Australia. The news made the headlines around the world. How does a young woman get involved in an international drug trafficking network?
results.name: Cocaine, Prison & Likes: Isabelle's True Story

results.overview: Set during the Franco-Prussian war  of 1870, Isabelle Laustin is a 15 year-old girl, born in a noble French family living in Paris. When Napoleon III' army loses the Paris siege she escapes to London, fighting as a secret agent for France.
results.name: Isabelle of Paris

results.overview: She is a priest, an idealist, and in love with her best friend's husband.
results.name: Isabella

results.overview: The fascinating story of the early life of England’s most iconic Queen, Elizabeth Tudor, an orphaned teenager who became embroiled in the political and sexual politics of the English court on her journey to obtain the crown.
results.name: Becoming Elizabeth
